name: DFS Benchmark Functions Dataset
description: A collection of benchmark optimization functions used to evaluate and compare optimization algorithms' performance.
reputation: A well-known collection of synthetic benchmark functions used in optimization and metaheuristics research; moderately cited in the optimization community.
notes: Non-ML benchmark of synthetic functions; performance is budget-dependent (evaluations/iterations) and not subject to model pretraining contamination; results vary widely by optimizer and settings.
